hero_desc_zh: 火红长发，黑铁鎏金符文战甲，火焰光晕环绕周身，面颊符文发光，以烈焰为武器（火焰冲击波、熔岩爆炸、烈焰横扫）
casual_opening_zh: 荒野中的寻常一刻——独自走在风蚀余烬的废墟小径上
casual_opening_en: an ordinary moment in the wilds — walking a lonely path through wind-worn, ember-lit ruins

opponent.desc_zh: 由淡蓝冰晶与白色寒雾构成的剑士，双眼透出冰蓝寒光，刃上拖曳霜雾
opponent.desc_en: swordsman of pale glacial ice and white frost-mist, ice-blue glowing eyes, frost trailing off its blade

environment.desc_en: colossal ancient library interior, towering bookshelf cliffs, dust floating in god-rays
environment.desc_zh: 巨大无比的远古图书馆内部，高耸如崖的书架，光柱中浮尘飞舞
